title: Coolant Temperature Sensor Low Error
detail_of_failure: A low voltage is sensed in the signal circuit of the engine coolant temperature sensor.
controller_action: Operates with coolant temperature as fixed value.
machine_effect: • The engine startability is degraded at low temperatures. • The overheat prevention function does not operate.
related_information: k Because hot water can blow out of the coolant temperature sensor installation part even if the radiator cap is removed when you test and replace the coolant temperature sensor, drain coolant by 10ℓ. • The input voltage from the engine coolant temperature sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 04105 (V)) • The temperature sensed by the engine coolant temperature sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 04107 (℃)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position. • If the temperature sensor connector is disconnected, failure code [CA144] for High Error is shown, not this failure code.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector COOLANT TEMP. Connect the socket to the male side. REMARK When the coolant temperature is 0℃ or above, if the resistance of the coolant temperature sensor is 700Ω to 37kΩ, the coolant temperature sensor is regarded as correct.

measurements.point: Between COOLANT TEMP (male) (A) and (B) (thermal characteristics of coolant temperature sensor) / 0℃

steps.cause: Short circuit in wiring ha ness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side. Between ECM (female) (15) and (38) (coolant temperr- ature: 0℃ and above) 700Ω to Resistance REMARK 37kΩ Accords with the characteristics table of the coolant temperature sensor-resistance value on cause 2.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (15) and (38) (coolant temperature: 0℃ and above) REMARK Accords with the characteristics table of the coolant temperature sensor-resistance value on cause 2.

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and COOLANT TEMP. Connect a T- adapter to the female side of ECM. Resistance Between ground and ECM (female) (15) Min. 100kΩ
- If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
